groups.saying_opens: يقوم من بعدي اثنا عشر أميرا

notes: Two sayings: the first is the Prophet's «يقوم من بعدي اثنا عشر أميرا» through Jabir b. Samura

The second («فسألت القوم وسألت أبي … فقال قال: كلهم من قريش») is a first-person narrative: the narrator's own question is not named as a link, and the father is the one who answers (needs_ruling, rule 11)
